items.title: Aurora
items.subtitle: Gradient engine
items.body: Smooth multi-stop gradients rendered per frame. Aurora stresses fill-rate and blending.

items.title: Ripple
items.subtitle: Touch feedback
items.body: Layered touch feedback and hover states. Ripple stresses input latency and hit-testing.

items.title: Cascade
items.subtitle: Staggered lists
items.body: Staggered entrances over long lists. Cascade stresses layout, animation scheduling and GC.

items.title: Orbit
items.subtitle: Custom painting
items.body: Continuous custom-drawn animation at display refresh rate. Orbit stresses the paint pipeline.

items.title: Spring
items.subtitle: Physics & gestures
items.body: Drag, release and settle with a damped spring. Spring stresses gesture handling and frame pacing.

items.title: Morph
items.subtitle: Theme & transitions
items.body: Whole-screen colour interpolation and shared-element flights. Morph stresses compositing.
